record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare ROCK_TOMB: Omanyte (1 star, range 2), Omastar (2 stars, range 2), Relicanth (3 stars, range 1). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count, range and maxPP (90 / 90 / 100). Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Single-target: deals SPECIAL damage (raw 30/60/120 by stars here; table 30/60/120/240) to the cast target and then lowers its Speed by a requested 10/20/40 (table 10/20/40/80). The speed change is unconditional (not skipped when the damage is blocked or kills) and has no timer in this strategy, so it lasts as long as nothing else restores it, and repeated casts stack until the Speed floor of 0. The requested -10/-20/-40 is not necessarily the applied change: Twist Band turns it into a gain, a MELMETAL victim loses half of it from Attack instead, and the Speed result is clamped to 0..300.

targeting.note: No area, no secondary targets. The damage and the speed change both go to the same cast target; the speed call is not conditioned on the returned damage result.

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]; handleSpecialDamage then x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so crit needs ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker / field / weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp), 0 with protect / skydiving / magicBounce; the returned values are not used by the strategy.

effects.scaling: called as addSpeed(-debuff, caster, 0, false): apBoost 0 and crit false, so neither AP nor crit scales it (the factor (1 + 0 x AP/100) x 1 is 1).
effects.resolution: requested = -10 / -20 / -40. Applied: addSpeed first runs Big Eater Belt (a negative value from an enemy caster is NOT scaled, so a belt holder keeps -debuff) and Twist Band (a Twist Band holder turns -debuff into +debuff, a Speed gain of the same size); the value is then added to speed and clamped to 0..300 (so a unit at speed 5 hit by -10 ends at 0, and the applied change is -5). A MELMETAL victim does not lose Speed: half the already adjusted value is sent to addAttack, which rounds it and runs Belt / Twist Band once more (a Twist-Band-flipped +debuff is then positive and, for a Belt holder, scaled x1.25 rounded down) and floors Attack at 1. There is no restore timer and no `permanent` flag in this call, so the change lasts for the rest of the fight in the simulation entity (no copy to the board unit). Casts add up. The speed change is applied whether or not the damage was blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (the speed call has no such guard).

starBehavior.note: Damage and speed reduction are both indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star values (240 / 80, also the ?? fallbacks) are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of these units. maxPP is 90 for Omanyte / Omastar and 100 for Relicanth; range 2 / 2 / 1.

record.positionalConditions: None: no positional or geometric condition in the strategy; the cast target is chosen by the generic targeting code before the strategy runs.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP; every cast deals damage again and lowers Speed again (cumulative, floored at 0 Speed). Nothing in the strategy restores the Speed later.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 30 / 60 / 120 and speed -10 / -20 / -40 (Omanyte / Omastar / Relicanth). Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. Applied speed change = requested after Twist Band (sign flip) and the 0..300 clamp (or, for MELMETAL, a half-sized Attack change after a second helper pass); Big Eater Belt does not scale an enemy's negative value; AP and crit do not change it.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate and the crit roll were read
Death handling in handleDamage beyond its early branches (resurrection, Cover Band, Shiny Charm) was not read; the speed call runs after it regardless
Whether other effects (cleanse, status removal, evolution, synergy) later reset or overwrite a reduced Speed was not examined
unresolved: How the simulation's attack-speed calculation uses the stored speed value (the effect of -10 / -20 / -40 on attack timing) was not traced here; only the stat change is described
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
Isolated numeric cases for the speed clamp and the MELMETAL branch come from reading addSpeed / addAttack, not from a probe
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
